# Security Checklist: Production Deployment Plan

**Purpose**: Validate security, privacy, secret, and evidence requirement quality before task generation
**Created**: 2026-06-04
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are production secret requirements complete for Postgres, MinIO root/init, MinIO API, smoke identity/device, MediaScribe, and Langfuse classes? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004, Contract §Required Secret Classes]
- [ ] CHK002 Are Docker secrets and environment template requirements complete enough to forbid live values while still documenting purpose, owner, rotation, and failure behavior? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004, Contract §Source Policy]
- [ ] CHK003 Are fail-closed requirements complete for missing secrets, dev defaults, root/admin API credentials, localhost endpoints, and unreadable secret files? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005, Contract §Fail-Closed Rules]
- [ ] CHK004 Are forbidden evidence content requirements complete for live secrets, tokens, signed URLs, raw audio, transcript text, raw logs, object keys, and external dependency credentials? [Completeness, Spec §FR-014/FR-016, Contract §Forbidden Evidence Content]
- [ ] CHK005 Are smoke identity/device requirements complete for isolation from real users, desktop uploader credentials, and local development seeds? [Completeness, Spec §FR-012a, Data Model §Smoke Identity And Device]
- [ ] CHK006 Are client boundary requirements complete enough to prevent desktop exposure of MinIO, MediaScribe, Langfuse credentials, and direct object-storage upload URLs? [Completeness, Spec §FR-017, Contract §Client Boundary]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK007 Is "no live secret values" clearly defined across specs, contracts, evidence, logs, templates, and screenshots? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004/FR-014, Contract §Forbidden Evidence Content]
- [ ] CHK008 Are safe placeholders distinguished from unsafe local-development defaults with objectively checkable criteria? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005, Contract §Fail-Closed Rules]
- [ ] CHK009 Are evidence summaries clearly constrained to metadata-only records, not raw logs or raw artifacts? [Clarity, Spec §FR-016, Contract §Smoke Evidence]
- [ ] CHK010 Is public reachability during smoke clearly separated from authorization, user access, and rollout readiness expectations? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001a/FR-022]
- [ ] CHK011 Are external dependency degraded-awareness checks clearly forbidden from creating MediaScribe jobs, Langfuse content traces, or content egress? [Clarity, Spec §FR-013, Contract §Required Side-Effect Assertions]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK012 Do secret source requirements align with the constitution rule that credentials must not be committed, logged, exposed in diagnostics, embedded in images, or shipped to clients? [Consistency, Constitution §III, Spec §FR-004/FR-014]
- [ ] CHK013 Are log/evidence redaction requirements consistent across smoke evidence, quickstart, success criteria, and contracts? [Consistency, Spec §SC-002/SC-008, Quickstart §11]
- [ ] CHK014 Are smoke identity requirements consistent with the absence of `013-federated-auth-foundation` and the decision not to reuse dev seed identities? [Consistency, Spec §Assumptions, Research §Dedicated internal smoke identity/device]
- [ ] CHK015 Are cleanup and residue-accounting requirements consistent with deletion truth and not overstating universal erasure? [Consistency, Constitution §IV, Spec §FR-018]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK016 Are secret validation success criteria measurable enough to distinguish missing, placeholder, dev default, and valid externalized secret states? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003, Contract §Fail-Closed Rules]
- [ ] CHK017 Are forbidden-content scan criteria measurable enough to determine whether committed evidence and logs are safe? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002/SC-008]
- [ ] CHK018 Are no-side-effect criteria measurable for MediaScribe jobs, Temporal workflows, notes jobs, retention jobs, deletion jobs, and content-bearing Langfuse traces? [Measurability, Spec §SC-007/SC-007a]
- [ ] CHK019 Are final verdict criteria measurable enough to reject unsafe readiness language in 100% of evidence records? [Measurability, Spec §SC-012, Contract §Readiness Verdicts]

## Scenario And Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK020 Are requirements defined for the security risk of public API reachability before real auth, uploader, dashboard, retention, and deletion slices exist? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases/FR-001a]
- [ ] CHK021 Are requirements defined for missing, malformed, expired, or wrong-class smoke credentials? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, Data Model §Smoke Identity And Device]
- [ ] CHK022 Are requirements defined for evidence generation when cleanup fails, logs contain forbidden content, or smoke identity/device provisioning is blocked? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases/FR-015/FR-018]
- [ ] CHK023 Are requirements defined for MinIO root/init credential separation from least-privilege API credentials? [Coverage, Contract §Required Secret Classes]
- [ ] CHK024 Are requirements defined for preventing shared platform Postgres/MinIO credential or bucket reuse in Rec-owned production deployment? [Coverage, Spec §FR-017, Plan §Technical Context]

## Dependencies And Assumptions

- [ ] CHK025 Are assumptions about owner-controlled MediaScribe/Langfuse and no desktop-held credentials explicit enough for security review? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions, Constitution §III]
- [ ] CHK026 Are security responsibilities for operator-provisioned secrets, rotation, and evidence ownership documented enough to avoid orphaned operational risk? [Dependency, Spec §FR-004/FR-016, Data Model §Secret And Environment Policy]

## Notes

- These items validate requirement quality only; they are not implementation test cases.
